# PlastiDip application on side moldings

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

[Partial] Clean plastic pieces with Dawn soap, rough up surfaces with fine grit sandpaper, then apply two to three light coats of PlastiDip. [t596]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Clean the plastic pieces thoroughly with Dawn soap to remove road oils.
2. Rough up the surface using a fine grit sandpaper, sanding block, or red sanding pad.

_Procedure reported by [t596]._
